title: feat: P0 spec compliance — timeline config, gallery navigation, empty state, navigation.view
body:
Implements all Priority 0 v1.0 UI Essentials from ROADMAP_SPEC.md (tasks #64, #66, #68, #71, #72).

### TimelineConfig spec alignment (#64, #72)
- Export `TimelineConfig` and `TimelineConfigSchema` from `@object-ui/types`
- Rename `dateField` → `startDateField` with backward compat fallback
- Add `endDateField`, `groupByField`, `colorField`, `scale` to ObjectTimeline

```tsx
<ObjectTimeline schema={{
  type: 'timeline',
  objectName: 'sprints',
  startDateField: 'start_date',  // spec-compliant (dateField still works)
  endDateField: 'end_date',
  groupByField: 'team',
  colorField: 'priority',
  scale: 'week',
}} />
```

### ObjectGallery navigation (#66)
- Integrate `useNavigationOverlay` + `NavigationOverlay` into ObjectGallery
- Accept `navigation` config and `onRowClick` prop, matching all other view plugins

### `navigation.view` property (#68)
- Expose `view` from `useNavigationOverlay` return value
- Pass `view` to `onNavigate(recordId, view)` for page mode
- Include view in URL path for `new_window` mode: `/{object}/{id}/{view}`

### ListView `emptyState` (#71)
- Add `emptyState?: { title?, message?, icon? }` to `ListViewSchema`
- Render centered empty state with dynamic Lucide icon resolution (kebab-case name → component)

```tsx
<ListView schema={{
  type: 'list-view',
  objectName: 'contacts',
  emptyState: {
    title: 'No contacts yet',
    message: 'Add your first contact to get started.',
    icon: 'users',
  },
}} />
```

### Also exported
- `NavigationConfig` and `NavigationConfigSchema` from `@object-ui/types` (from spec)

### Already complete (verified)
- #65: `GalleryConfig` already exported
- #67: `navigation.width` already flows via `{...navigation}` spread in all view plugins
